name: Haiku contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Contrarian recovery in AI-disrupted SaaS (ADBE, CRM down 49%), deeply beaten crypto (BTC/ETH -27-39%), and fintech; expect 2H rebound as market reverses AI-disruption panic, regulatory clarity emerges, and risk-on sentiment persists post-April drawdown.

positions.thesis: Firefly AI monetization under pressure: ARR growth revised to 8.3% FY vs 50% QoQ expected, margin headwinds from AI compute costs, freemium cannibalization of Creative Cloud. However, Topaz acquisition (video/image AI) and enterprise partnerships with Anthropic/Claude suggest recovery arc. Await Sep 10 earnings for clarity on magnitude of slowdown and cost mitigation success.

Agentforce momentum accelerating beyond expectations: ARR surged 205% to $1.2B, deal count up 50% sequentially, combined Einstein/Agentforce AI ARR now $2.9B (200%+ YoY). Enterprise adoption at scale confirmed. Increase conviction as execution trajectory proves out—market underestimating velocity of enterprise AI adoption.

Fintech recovery play: Q2 showed record 27% gross margins and Cash App strong 31% YoY growth despite Bitcoin segment weakness. Beneficiary of rate-cut scenario improving credit availability and consumer fintech adoption. Bitcoin/AI integration advancing with improved macro tailwinds.

Macro recovery: July jobs collapse (-23k vs +80k expected) shifted Fed from hold to cut expectations. Institutional adoption and ETF flows provide floor. Rate-cut scenario supportive of risk assets and crypto recovery. Hedge against growth-stock revaluation on easing.
Layer 2 scaling and institutional adoption tailwinds intact. Rate-cut scenario reduces discount rates on growth-oriented blockchain infrastructure. Tactical recovery exposure in macro easing cycle.

Removed due to redundancy: Bitcoin proxy with 843k BTC holdings creates over-leverage vs 12% direct BTC exposure already adequate. Trim to improve capital efficiency and reduce concentrated beta to BTC volatility.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-08: CRM Agentforce execution confirmed with 205% ARR surge and 50% sequential deal growth justifies increased conviction. MSTR (7%) is redundant BTC proxy given direct 12% BTC exposure—trim for capital efficiency and reduce over-leverage risk. SQ benefits from fintech recovery and rate cut scenario. Crypto positions strengthen as Fed shifts to easing expectations. Slight cash buffer for execution clarity.
research_notes: July 2026 jobs data (-23k vs +80k expected, wages 3.2% YoY) shifted Fed from rate-hold to easing expectations (Sep hike odds dropped 57%→44%, cut pricing now active). This inverts my Round 3 thesis. CRM Agentforce execution confirmed strong (ARR surged 205% to $1.2B, 50% sequential deal growth) but ADBE ARR growth slowed to 8.3% FY with margin pressure from AI costs and freemium cannibalization—awaiting Sep 10 earnings clarity. SQ shows strong Cash App (+31% YoY) and record margins despite Bitcoin segment weakness. BTC/ETH benefiting from rate-cut expectations. Gold miner shorts (GDX/GDXJ) rightly closed on squeeze risk. Round 2 thesis half-right (CRM strong, ADBE weakening) but crypto tailwinds now stronger. Round 3 thesis fundamentally broken: higher rates are now giving way to cuts, undermining KRE NIM expansion thesis and requiring pivot to growth + crypto positioned for easing cycle.
